This marks the end of a ten-year journey for the Munich-based company, which once made global headlines with its solar-powered car, the Sion. title: Ledger 指出 Coldcard 漏洞顯示 Bitcoin 錢包安全需因應 AI 調整
content: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet says the Coldcard exploit underscores why certified hardware randomness matters—and why AI is reshaping wallet security.
summary_zh: Ledger CTO 表示 Coldcard 漏洞凸顯硬體驗證隨機性重要，AI 正改變錢包安全需求。

title: Jim Cramer 因量子威脅計畫賣出 Bitcoin，加密社群反應熱烈
content: The CNBC host announced the decision on air after interviewing IBM CEO Arvind Krishna, asking him whether quantum computers could eventually crack the cryptography protecting his coins.
summary_zh: Jim Cramer 訪談 IBM CEO 後宣布因量子計算威脅賣出 Bitcoin，加密社群反應熱烈。

title: 今年已有 37 名美國人因反對 AI 資料中心抗議遭警方逮捕
content: Dozens of arrests tied to opposition against AI data centers underscore how local disputes over massive computing projects are growing into a national political movement.
summary_zh: 今年已有 37 名美國人因反對 AI 資料中心抗議而被捕，顯示地方爭議擴大為全國議題。

title: Coldcard Bitcoin 漏洞解析：Entropy、金鑰生成與 Bits 重要性
content: A flaw in Coldcard wallets cost Bitcoin holders more than $100 million—and reopened an old fight about whether you can trust dice.
summary_zh: Coldcard 錢包 Entropy 漏洞已造成逾 1 億美元損失，重新引發對骰子生成金鑰的信任爭議。

title: Solana 提案將每日 SOL 銷毀量增加逾 10 倍
content: Validators are considering changes that would increase the amount of SOL permanently removed from circulation while reducing the rate of new token issuance.
summary_zh: Solana 驗證者正考慮修改提案，把每日 SOL 永久銷毀量增加 10 倍以上並降低新幣發行率。

title: Alibaba 免費開放最佳 AI 模型 Qwen Max，幾乎匹敵 Claude 與 ChatGPT
content: The first Qwen Max model with public weights is free to download next week. Alibaba's own scorecard says the Americans still win on code.
summary_zh: Alibaba 將於下週開放 Qwen Max 公開權重模型免費下載， scorecard 顯示美國模型在程式碼仍領先。

title: Hashdex 因資產規模不足將關閉美國 Bitcoin ETF
content: The Brazil-based crypto asset manager will liquidate its U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF later this month, ending a fund that entered the market in 2024.
summary_zh: 巴西資產管理公司 Hashdex 將於本月底清算美國現貨 Bitcoin ETF，該基金 2024 年才上市。

title: Apple AI 垃圾問題導致 20 萬美元 macOS 漏洞未被通報
content: A Milan start-up says it found a full-takeover flaw in macOS using ChatGPT, then hit Apple's new submission cap before it could file it.
summary_zh: 米蘭新創用 ChatGPT 發現 macOS 完整接管漏洞，因 Apple 提交上限而無法通報，損失 20 萬美元。

title: Morning Minute: Saylor 再次出售 Bitcoin
content: Strategy sold $104M in Bitcoin last week to help prop up STRC, a financial product they created to… help them buy more Bitcoin.
summary_zh: Strategy 上週出售 1.04 億美元 Bitcoin 以支撐其金融產品 STRC。

title: BlackRock 與 JP Morgan 的 Kinexys 將 3110 億美元歐洲貨幣市場基金代幣化
content: Europe's largest cash management platform is now issuing tokens on Ethereum, in a launch restricted to professional investors.
summary_zh: BlackRock 透過 JP Morgan Kinexys 在 Ethereum 上將 3110 億美元歐洲貨幣市場基金代幣化，限專業投資人。

title: Hardware Wallet Firms Warn of Phishing Surge as Coldcard Losses Near $130M
content: Fake "coordinated hardware audit" emails are steering holders to a cloned Coldcard site that installs remote-access software.

title: Five Convicted of Imprisoning Crypto Millionaires in London 'Torture' Ordeal
content: Two of the five were also convicted of conspiracy to blackmail, in a case police won without either victim testifying.

title: Marmot 研究人員轉向 OnlyFans 募資並推出 Meme Coins
content: Scientists are using OnlyFans to help fund decades of marmot research, while unofficial memecoins inspired by the project have emerged on Solana.
summary_zh: 研究人員利用 OnlyFans 為 marmot 研究募資，並在 Solana 推出相關 meme coins。
